title: Task State
description: Runtime state tracking for a task's step progression.

taskId.description: The task this state belongs to.

stepOrder.description: Ordered list of step IDs defining the execution sequence.

reopenCount.description: Number of times this task has been reopened for repair.

repairRequired.description: Whether the task currently requires repair.

reworkFrom.description: Set when a rejection routed work backwards, and cleared once the reopened step succeeds. Carries why the step was reopened, which repairErrors cannot express: a repair means the output was malformed, a rework means it was well-formed and unsatisfactory.

comment.description: The rejection comment — the specialist's rework context.

output.description: Path to the rejecting step's output.json, relative to the task directory. It is not reachable through priorOutputs, which maps only steps before the current index.
